spans.s: N. of a race (said to have been descendants of Yadu; they are described in the Purāṇas as separated into 5 divisions, viz. the Tālajaṅghas, Vīti-hotras, Āvantyas, Tuṇḍikeras, and Jātas; they are, said to have overrun parts of India along with the Śakas or Scythian tribes), MBh.; R.; Pur. &c.
a king of the Haihayas (esp. applied to Arjuna Kārtavīrya, who is said to have had a thousand arms; see कार्तवीर्य), ib.
N. of a son of Sahasrada, Hariv.
of a son of Śata-jit, Pur.
N. of Arjuna Kārtavīrya (cf. above), L.
